recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-layered composition featuring a close-up, angled view of a guitar fretboard against a swirling, organic background of warm reds and oranges, anchored by large, rounded, bubble-style typography with thick outlines.
coreVisualRelationships: Large display text dominates the left and center foreground.
A diagonal guitar neck provides a structural counterpoint from the top right.
Organic, blob-like background shapes mimic 1960s liquid light shows.
A dark header bar provides a stable anchor for secondary metadata.
coreInvariants: Diagonal composition of the musical instrument
Heavy black outlines on primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary text is scaled to fill the left two-thirds of the frame; the guitar neck occupies the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large '60s' numeral in the top left acts as the initial entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left text, down through the stacked words, then up the diagonal guitar neck to the top header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with color and form to evoke energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Red and deep orange provide the saturated background base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow and light orange are used for text fills to pop against the dark red.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal or muted blue appears in the guitar body/background for cool-tone contrast.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with dark drop shadows and outlines to maintain legibility.

letterConstructionRules: Thick dark brown or black outer stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' and 'y' (if used) should have looped, circular descenders
The ampersand is simplified into a fluid, curvy shape
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, organic display lettering and clean, wide-tracked geometric metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric, rounded 70s/60s transition aesthetic.
Matches the circular, tubular construction of the main display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s psychedelic background with swirling red and orange organic shapes. In the upper right, include a close-up, diagonal view of a guitar neck with visible frets and strings. Add a solid black horizontal bar across the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked bubble-style text on the left side using a yellow-to-orange gradient and thick black outlines. In the top black bar, add wide-spaced, teal-colored geometric sans-serif text in all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the main text stacked and left-aligned?
Does the guitar neck run diagonally from top-right?
Is the color palette dominated by warm reds and yellows?
Are the letters heavily rounded with thick outlines?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top left corner
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the guitar frets entirely.
Check that the teal text in the header is legible against black.
Verify the 'bubble' quality of the main font terminals.
Confirm the background feels fluid and organic rather than geometric.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Organic Psychedelic Background] + [Diagonal Instrument Detail] + [Stacked Bubble Typography] + [High-Contrast Header Bar] to create a retro music aesthetic.
